title: CVE-2026-129448: Apache Roller
summary: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. title: CVE-2026-76466: Cisco Expressway Series

title: CVE-2026-90817: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap)
summary: Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. An attacker could exploit this via crafted HTTP requests that access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and supply a crafted file-path or stream parameter during data import processing. Exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash.

title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis
summary: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

title: CVE-2026-115731: Perforce Puppet Enterprise

If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.

title: CVE-2026-114713: UnrealIRCd UnrealIRCd

An authenticated local user can send a command to the socket and have it executed as root.

summary: MLflow is an open source AI engineering platform for agents, large language models, and machine learning models. summary: A (fictional) state appellate court held a retailer liable for refund promises made by its customer-service chatbot, rejecting the argument that the chatbot was a separate agent responsible for its own statements.
